What element of the circle is depicted in the diagram above?
worked_solution: We can see that $\overset{―}{JK}$ is a line segment whose endpoints lie on the circle. So, $\overset{―}{JK}$ is a chord. It is not a diameter since the line segment does not pass through the center of the circle.

Correct
EXPLANATION

We can see that JK― is a line segment whose endpoints lie on the circle. So, JK― is a chord. It is not a diameter since the line segment does not pass through the center of the circle.
